settings.title: Settings — {project}
settings.name: Name
settings.defaultModelHint: tasks without their own model use this one
settings.enrichHint: Before implementing, the agent rewrites "## Descrição" to be clearer and grounded in the code. "Claude decides": only rewrites when it judges the description vague. Each task can override this in its details (the ✦ selector).
settings.timeoutHint: between 1 and 240 min. Applies from the next run on.
settings.verifyHint: Run in the task's worktree after the run. If it fails, the task goes back to "To Do" with the output in the error log instead of moving to "Done". Empty: no verification.
settings.retriesNote: With a backoff above zero and auto-pilot on, a failing task is rescheduled N minutes ahead instead of going straight back to the queue. 0 = back on the next tick (default behaviour).
settings.autoDecomposeHint: Before running, Claude evaluates every task without its own split setting: if it is too large, it is broken into smaller subtasks instead of running whole.
settings.pullBeforeStart: Pull the main branch before starting each task
settings.useCurrentBranch: Use the current branch (don't switch to the main one)
settings.useCurrentBranchHint: Ignores the main branch and the pull: the task starts from the repository's current state.
settings.commitToNewBranchWorktree: With worktrees on, a new branch is mandatory (a git requirement).
settings.commitToNewBranchHint: Unchecked: commits to the starting branch. Careful: the guardrails block commits on main/master.
settings.useWorktree: Use an isolated worktree per task
settings.useWorktreeHint: Each task runs in its own worktree (~/.claude-kanban/worktrees), leaving your checkout untouched.
settings.autoPushHint: Unchecked: the task only commits locally; you push it yourself.
settings.autoPR: Open a PR automatically (gh pr create)
settings.autoPRHint: Requires the GitHub CLI (gh) authenticated in the repository.
settings.autoPRNeedsPush: Requires automatic push to be on.
settings.autoPRDescriptionHint: Unchecked: the PR gets a minimal description for you to write later.
settings.skipPermissionsHint: Suppresses permission prompts in this project's next sessions. The deterministic guardrails (no reading .env, no committing on main, no deleting branches/external files) stay active. Sessions already running are unaffected.
settings.removeWarning: This reverts the settings.json merge and deletes .claude/claude-kanban/ (including the tasks). Confirm?
settings.removeFinal: Final confirmation: uninstall guardrails and remove the project?
globalPause.pausedTip: Nothing leaves the queue; sessions already running finish normally.
globalPause.criticalTip: {name} at {pct}% — consider pausing the global queue.
globalPause.tip: Global pause: no task from any project leaves the queue; active ones finish.
globalPause.drainNote: Drain mode: running sessions finish, nothing new starts.

globalSettings.concurrencyHint: parallel runs across every project. Projects without an isolated worktree are limited to 1 at a time.
